farmhouse.notes: Meshy remake (proof V20; polished: porch lamp; since the roof review the roof slopes carry their own tiling 512 px tile texture, material Roof, and the atlas is 1024 px q85). Nodes Smoke (chimney top), PorchLight (porch lamp spot) and PorchLamp (a hanging lantern there). Two materials are named Glow: the TEXTURED one = the painted walls + an emissive window mask (drive its emissive intensity, do not replace it); the UNTEXTURED one = the lamp glass (swap it for the glow material).

windmill.notes: Meshy (V21; 1024 px q85 texture since the texture review). Blades spins on local Z (procedural sails, vertex colours). Material Glow = textured window band + emissive mask: drive its emissive intensity, do not replace it.

well.notes: Meshy (V21). No Tint material yet (the studio tint feature cannot repaint it).

haystack.notes: Meshy (V21; polished to 0.9 wide x 0.84 tall, the brief radius 0.45). Meadow haystacks (the game draws Haystack procedurally today).

cart.notes: Meshy (V21). Meadow prop; no game slot yet.

hero_tree.notes: Meshy (V21; polished to 3.4 u tall; 1024 px q85 texture since the texture review). The big round tree at STATIC_TREES[0] in the proof; Canopy = the crown, pivoted near the trunk top. HOME_FENCE[0] runs through its trunk at that spot (art/meshy/README.md).

rock_c.notes: Meshy boulder_c, a flat slab (V21 rocks).

outcrop_b.notes: Meshy (V21). Mossy outcrop, 1.9 u tall; highland riser in the proof.

sheep.notes: Procedural (flat palette materials), ~0.74 tall x 0.81 long (the brief size). Head = the grazing pivot at the neck.

plot.notes: Painted procedural (scripts/assets/plot.mjs + the painted atlas, lib/paintedAtlas.mjs: one textured material, baked shade in COLOR_0; ART-PLAN P0-1). A tilled soil bed of three furrow rows along X (the atlas soil cell: soil.bed #6E5444, shade #5B4538, dry #8A6B55), crests ~0.174 and troughs ~0.146 around the crops' y 0.16, inside weathered grey board edging. 1.02 x 1.02 outside, the soil top 0.94 x 0.94, 0.185 tall, origin at the base centre on y 0. Same footprint as the old flat plot: Garden.tsx needs no change.

chicken.notes: Meshy (batch 2). 0.45 tall (brief), faces +Z. Head = cut off by a plane from the nape to the throat, pivot at the nape (0, 0.31, 0.04): a forward peck dips it into the chest. Flat caps on both sides of the cut. Cream coat (the game tints instances).

duck.notes: Meshy (batch 2). 0.30 tall, faces +Z. y 0 = the waterline: the hull dips to y -0.05 (the game puts the origin ~0.02 above the water, so ~0.03 of hull sits under it).

dog.notes: Meshy (batch 2). 0.55 tall x 0.72 long, faces +Z (head turned a little to +X, as in its concept). Head cut by a nape-to-throat plane, pivot at the nape (0, 0.45, 0.14); Tail cut across its base, pivot (0, 0.33, -0.2), wags on Y. 1,918 tris with the clean cuts: 28 % over the 1,500 animal budget.

cat_sleeping.notes: Meshy (batch 2). Curled ginger tabby, 0.23 tall x 0.52 x 0.45. Its sleeping face looks along +X (the game yaws the cat -0.4 so +X points at the farmhouse door and the camera sees the face). Head = the whole head (both ears, the full face), cut under the chin and behind the head; pivot at the back-top of the head (0, 0.16, 0.13), so a chin-up tilt (rotation.z ~0.3) hides the cut far better than a +y lift, which shows the flat cut surfaces.

goat.notes: Meshy (batch 2). 0.68 tall x 0.75 long, faces +Z. Ivory with warm-brown patches. Head (with both horns and the beard) cut by a nape-to-throat plane, pivot at the nape (0, 0.5, 0.08): grazing dips it into the chest.

lighthouse.notes: Meshy (batch 2). 3.75 tall, door on +Z, plinth r ~0.83. Material Glow = textured lamp-room glass + emissive mask (drive its intensity, do not replace it). Beam = an empty at the scene root in the lamp room centre (0, 2.67, 0.06), lower than the stand-in lamp (y 3.05).

greenhouse.notes: Meshy (batch 2, greenhouse v2): frosted glass on a stone base with a terracotta ridge, a climbing vine and pots by the door. 2.05 (ridge along X) x 1.50 tall x 1.21 deep, door on +X. The frosted panes are painted and opaque (plant silhouettes on them): no Glass material, so the game draws them solid.

beehive.notes: Meshy (batch 2). 0.42 x 0.73 x 0.42 with its tiled roof, entrance and landing board on +Z. No bees modelled (the game flies its own).

lantern.notes: Meshy (batch 2). Post on the origin, 0.9 tall, the lantern hangs from an arm on +X (glass x 0.17-0.28, y 0.49-0.65). Material Glow = textured glass + emissive mask (drive its intensity, do not replace it). The moth perch (0.18, 0.885) is on the arm.

scarecrow.notes: Meshy (batch 2). 1.45 tall, faces +Z; the concept arms are 1.25 across (brief 0.85), above the crops.

woodshed.notes: Painted procedural (scripts/assets/woodshed.mjs + the painted atlas, lib/paintedAtlas.mjs: one textured material, one 512 px sRGB JPEG albedo, baked shade in COLOR_0). Lean-to, origin at the base centre on y 0, open front +Z: posts 1.0 x 0.6, the terracotta roof (tile courses, darker trim) ~0.84 over the back posts and ~0.65 over the front, overhanging to 1.16 x 0.76 (1.16 x 0.79 overall: the axe head pokes 2 cm past the front edge of the roof), 0.89 tall; stone footing, back wall of boards, 22 logs (rows 6/5/6/5) with painted ring ends on +Z, an axe on the front-left post. For <Asset id="woodshed" fallback={<WoodshedShell/>}>.

wetland_jetty.notes: Painted procedural (scripts/assets/wetland_jetty.mjs + the painted atlas, one textured material). y 0 = the waterline (set it on the lake level). Runs along Z centred on the origin, 0.7 x 1.7: the SHORE end at -Z (z -0.85, a sill log under it at y 0.11-0.16 for the bank), the far end at +Z. Deck top y 0.2 on four piles down to y -0.3 (wet below the waterline); mooring post to 0.45 with a rope loop at (0.3, 0.74), a bucket and a stool on the far end.

barnaby.notes: Painted procedural (scripts/assets/barnaby.mjs + the painted atlas, one textured material). Barnaby Wick, the wizard: ONE rigid mesh on the single root node "barnaby" (rotate that node to rock him). Origin at his feet on y 0, facing +Z, 1.06 tall, every vertex within 0.26 u of the y axis (his robe hem is the widest part, 0.256). A tall pointed hat (its tip flops to his left, +X) with a brass band, a slate-teal robe, a rust scarf, hands clasped in front, a brass lantern at his left hip, a satchel of papers at his right hip. For <Asset id="barnaby" fallback={<BarnabyShell/>}>.

tower_ruin.notes: Painted procedural (scripts/assets/tower_ruin.mjs + the painted atlas, one textured material). The broken base of a round dry-stone tower, centred on the origin (the ring centre), base on y 0, ~2.0 across, 1.28 tall at the back (-Z), knee height at the sides, open front +Z. Back wall inner face 0.73 from the centre; Barnaby stands at model (0, -0.40). The game turns it so +Z points along piece-local (0.41, 0.91): rotation.y = atan2(0.41, 0.91) = 0.423 rad.

barnaby_camp.notes: Painted procedural (scripts/assets/barnaby_camp.mjs + the painted atlas, one textured material). Lean-to over a bedroll, origin at the footprint centre on y 0, open front +Z (rotation.y pi/4 to face the default camera, like the woodshed); 1.0 x 0.7, 0.70 tall. Forked poles and a ridge pole, a patched canvas tarp sloping to the back, guy lines and pegs; a bedroll with a check blanket and a rolled pillow; books with a candle stub and a kettle on three stones out front.

shelter.notes: Painted procedural (scripts/assets/shelter.mjs + the painted atlas, lib/paintedAtlas.mjs: one textured material, one 512 px sRGB JPEG albedo, baked shade in COLOR_0). The meadow's open sheep lean-to; the SAME FILE as sheep_shelter.glb (identical bytes, root node "shelter"). Origin at the base centre on y 0, open front +Z: keep the game's rotation 0.7 at MEADOW.shelter and the open side and the hay face the default camera. 1.40 x 1.10, 1.35 tall: a terracotta tile roof high at the open front (~1.35) and low at the back (eave ~0.74), plank sheathing on three rafters under it, a stone footing under the back and the sides, a plank back wall, low plank side walls (~0.56), two front posts at x +-0.58, z 0.40 (the opening between them is 1.08 wide); inside, a hay bale tied with twine against the back wall and a little loose hay. For <Asset id="shelter" fallback={today's Shelter mesh}>.

sheep_shelter.notes: The identical file to shelter.glb (the same bytes: built from scripts/assets/shelter.mjs, root node "shelter"; ASSETS.md sheep_shelter: "ship the identical file under this id too"). See the shelter entry for the model.

visitor_hare.notes: Meshy (the owner's concept B: sitting up, one ear turned out as if listening). The meadow's brown hare, 0.21 wide (the turned ear) x 0.45 tall x 0.27 long, base on y 0, facing +Z; warm golden-brown coat, cream chest, ink ear tips. ONE mesh, one 512 px albedo, no bones or named nodes yet (no Head: the rig task on art/animal-rigs re-skins it as hare_rig with Head, ears, lids and Idle / Look / EarTwitch / Groom / Hop / Alert clips). The game's <Asset id="visitor_hare"> draws it unscaled (the Visitors.tsx `scale` applies to the stand-in only).
